les: Die hoes wat nie wou weggaan nie
kaps_punt: Leesvaardighede: lees met begrip en die gebruik van 'n woordeboek: Lees oor die oorsake, simptome en behandeling van plaaslike gesondheidsprobleme wat gereeld voorkom: herroep en vertel.

items.bewering: Die suster het gesê dit is tuberkulose, en almal noem dit TB. TB kom van kieme wat in 'n mens se longe kan groei.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: WHO, Tuberculosis (https://www.who.int/tb; https://www.who.int/westernpacific/health-topics/tuberculosis): TB is caused by bacteria (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) and most often affects the lungs. 'kan groei' leaves room for TB elsewhere in the body; 'kieme' is a fair Grade 5 word for bacteria.

items.bewering: Die suster het gesê die lang hoes, die nagsweet en die moegheid is simptome van TB.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: WHO TB fact sheet: common symptoms are prolonged cough, chest pain, weakness or fatigue, weight loss, fever and night sweats. The story's food left on the plate is consistent with the weight loss/poor appetite WHO and CDC list, and is not stated as a symptom.

items.bewering: Die suster het gesê TB loop deur die lug en nie deur 'n beker of 'n bord nie.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: CDC TB fact sheets and pamphlet (https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/13224/cdc_13224_DS1.pdf; https://espanol.cdc.gov/tb/publications/pamphlets/tb_disease_en_rev.pdf): TB germs go into the air when a person with lung TB coughs or speaks and are breathed in; TB is not spread by sharing food or drink, drinking containers or eating utensils.

items.bewering: Sy het bygevoeg dat nie elke hoes TB is nie. 'n Gewone hoes hou langer aan as wat mense dink.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: Ebell, Lundgren & Youngpairoj, 'How Long Does a Cough Last?', Annals of Family Medicine 2013;11(1):5-13 (https://www.annfammed.org/node/2649): acute cough lasts on average 17.8 days, while people surveyed expected about 7-9 days.

items.bewering: So 'n hoes is gewoonlik binne drie tot vier weke weg.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: NHS cough guidance as reproduced by NHS 111 Wales (https://111.wales.nhs.uk/cough): a cough usually clears up within 3 to 4 weeks; see a doctor if it lasts more than 3 weeks.

items.bewering: Die kliniek gaan wel elke hoes van twee weke of langer na. Hulle kyk dit liewer te vroeg as te laat na. Jy kan gerus vroeër kom as jy bekommerd is.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: Western Cape Government Health (https://westerncape.gov.za/gc-news/413/7911): anyone coughing for more than 2 weeks should go to the nearest clinic to be tested for TB; National Department of Health Clinical Resource Guide (knowledgehub.health.gov.za) uses cough over two weeks as the TB screening question (any duration for people living with HIV). 'Elke hoes van twee weke of langer' is a true floor, and 'vroeër kom' does not conflict with the shorter threshold for some groups.

items.bewering: Sy het hom 'n bottel gegee om slym in op te hoes. Die bottel is vir 'n toets weggestuur. Twee dae later het hulle teruggestap om die uitslag te kry.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: NDoH TB Screening and Testing SOP 2022 (https://sahivsoc.org/Files/NDoH_TB%20SCREENING%20AND%20TESTING%20SOP%202022.pdf): sputum is collected for laboratory testing; NHLS/ASLM 2026 dashboard (https://aslm.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ASLM_EndTB_Dashboard_Presentation_29052026.pdf): over 90% of TB molecular test results available within 40 hours, so a two-day wait for the result is realistic. The nurse listening to the chest is narrative detail and makes no claim about how TB is diagnosed.

items.bewering: Die suster het gesê TB kan gesond gemaak word.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: WHO TB fact sheet: TB is curable and preventable, usually with a six-month course of four antibiotics; Western Cape Government Health: TB and MDR-TB are treatable and curable.

items.bewering: Oom Frans moet sy medisyne elke dag drink, ook nadat hy weer goed begin voel het.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: NICE NG33 patient information, 'Finishing all your treatment' (https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng33/ifp/chapter/Finishing-all-your-treatment): keep taking the medicine even when you feel well, because stopping early lets TB come back and become resistant; CDC fact sheet: feeling better after a few weeks does not mean all the TB germs are dead. WHO's standard regimen is taken daily.

items.bewering: Hy moet baie maande lank aanhou, want dit gee hom die beste kans om gesond te word.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: WHO TB fact sheet: standard treatment is six months; CDC fact sheet: TB medicine must be taken correctly for at least 6 months to be cured; NICE NG33: missed doses or stopping early make return and resistance likely. Completing the full course is the established condition for cure, so 'die beste kans' holds and does not overpromise a cure.

items.bewering: Ná 'n paar weke se medisyne gee iemand die siekte gewoonlik nie meer oor nie. (Herhaal later: 'Ná so lank gee iemand die siekte gewoonlik nie meer oor nie.')
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: CDC 'Questions and Answers about TB' (archived, https://cybercemetery.unt.edu/oilspill/20121017020441mp_/http://www.cdc.gov/tb/publications/faqs/qa_TBDisease.htm): after taking medicine for about 2 or 3 weeks a person may no longer be able to spread TB; a doctor decides. 'Gewoonlik' correctly leaves room for exceptions such as drug-resistant TB, and Ruan sitting beside Oom Frans after several weeks of treatment follows from this without overstating it.

items.bewering: Sy het gesê die mense wat elke dag by hom was, moet ook kom om nagegaan te word.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: Household contact investigation is recommended practice in South Africa: LSHTM/Glasgow research on SA contact tracing (https://researchonline.lshtm.ac.uk/id/eprint/2549753; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9477445), describing referral of household contacts under SA guidelines; CDC: people with TB most often spread it to those they spend time with every day.

items.bewering: Ná 'n paar weke het die hoes minder geword, en hy het weer begin eet.
items.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
items.bron: CDC fact sheet (https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/13224/cdc_13224_DS1.pdf): patients usually feel better after a few weeks on TB medicine. The story then says treatment carried on for many more months, which is correct.

opsomming: All 13 checkable claims in this TB reading are confirmed, including its one superlative ('die beste kans', which holds), and the lesson contains no analogy, so nothing needs fixing.
